definitions.explanation: a heating system installed beneath the floor surface to warm a room from below

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{部屋|へや}→部屋：00507_heya⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{床暖房|ゆかだんぼう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧ついて⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧。
{床暖房|ゆかだんぼう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦つける→つける：00562_tsukeru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{足元|あしもと}→足元：04096_ashimoto⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{暖|あたた}かく→暖かい：00618_atatakai⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧。
examples.english: When you turn on the floor heating, it warms you from your feet up.

examples.japanese: ⟦{新|あたら}しい→新しい：00506_atarashii⟧⟦マンション→マンション：01035_manshon⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{床暖房|ゆかだんぼう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{標準|ひょうじゅん}→標準：04832_hyoujun⟧⟦{装備|そうび}→装備：14103_soubi⟧⟦されている→する：00392_suru⟧こと⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{多|おお}い→多い：01127_ooi⟧。
examples.english: Many new apartment buildings come with floor heating as a standard feature.

notes:
Composed of ⟦{床|ゆか}→床：03652_yuka⟧ (floor) + ⟦{暖房|だんぼう}→暖房：01657_danbou⟧ (heating). A popular feature in modern Japanese homes and apartments. Often abbreviated as {床暖|ゆかだん} in casual speech and real estate listings.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {床暖房|ゆかだんぼう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦つける→つける：00562_tsukeru⟧: to turn on the floor heating
- {床暖房|ゆかだんぼう}⟦{付|つ}き→付き：26333_tsuki⟧: equipped with floor heating
- {床暖房|ゆかだんぼう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{設置|せっち}する→設置する：26989_secchisuru⟧: to install floor heating
- ⟦ガス→ガス：01344_gasu⟧{式|しき}{床暖房|ゆかだんぼう}: gas-powered floor heating
- ⟦{電気|でんき}→電気：09780_denki⟧{式|しき}{床暖房|ゆかだんぼう}: electric floor heating

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦エアコン→エアコン：05282_eakon⟧: air conditioner — the most common heating/cooling device in Japan
- ⟦{暖房|だんぼう}→暖房：01657_danbou⟧: heating — general term for any heating system
- こたつ: kotatsu — a heated table with a blanket, a traditional Japanese heating method

NOTE: Floor heating is valued in Japan because the floor-sitting lifestyle makes foot warmth especially important. It is a major selling point in real estate.
